### Rulings that bind ###
- **R1 The projection.** In `apps/wired/wired/composition.py`, a new `_build_dtc_dna_view(vin_dna) -> DtcLabDnaView |
  None` (import `DtcLabDnaView` from `dtclab.schemas.dna_view`). It maps `air_metering_strategy` `MAF_ONLY` → `MAF`,
  `MAP_ONLY_SPEED_DENSITY` → `MAP_SPEED_DENSITY`, `DUAL_MAF_MAP_CROSSCHECK` → `HYBRID`, and `resolved_horizon`
  `HORIZON_LEGACY` → `HORIZON_LEGACY`, `HORIZON_ADAPTIVE` → `HORIZON_CLASSIC` (both Euro 3-4), `HORIZON_MODERN` →
  `HORIZON_MODERN`, each table citing `DTC_VOCABULARY.md` §14.1. `emissions` takes `vin_dna["emissions"]`'s
  `has_catalyst` and `egr_equipped`; `make` and `model` default to `""`; a Euro value outside `EURO_1`..`EURO_7` becomes
  `UNKNOWN`; `confidence` is copied. It returns `None` (DTC_VOCABULARY §14.3: None is confidence NONE) when either flag
  is not a bool, `model_year` is None, either enum is unmapped, or `confidence` is not HIGH, PARTIAL or NONE. A
  `# consumer:` comment names the routing_tag_mapper HIGH gates.
- **R2 The call.** `_run_dtclab(dtc_inputs, vin_dna)` builds `DataFusionSanitizer(dna_view=_build_dtc_dna_view(vin_dna))`;

  DTCLab.
